info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Knowledge Base Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). An author drafts an article (keywords normalised, linked to a problem), updates it, submits it, and shows the review rules: nobody publishes or returns their own article (409), a return needs a comment, a returned article is edited and submitted again, and a different reviewer publishes it. The text search (q) finds it by a word of its body and finds nothing for a word that is nowhere, and the collection filters by problem. A new version of the published article is a new draft with the same key (a second one at the same time is refused with 409), and publishing it retires version 1 as SUPERSEDED; the versions and the audit ledger read in order. A second folder proves the two audiences: a REQUESTER reads only published public articles, without the people and links (internal, draft and retired ones answer 404), searches only inside that set whatever they ask, and is refused (403 ERR-KNB-00403) on every staff route. Negative cases cover validation, illegal transitions (409), tenant isolation and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It files its own articles under its own generated tenant id (kbOrganisationId) and two generated people (kbAuthorId, kbReviewerId), so it needs no organisationId from the Party Reference Data Directory.
